name: Removal Creates Win (Gravity Collapse)
description: P0 has pieces at row 5 cols 0-2, and a piece at row 4 col 3 sitting on top of P1's piece at row 5 col 3. If P0 removes P1's piece at (row 5, col 3), gravity drops P0's piece from row 4 to row 5 col 3 — completing a horizontal 4-in-a-row for P0 at row 5. Tests whether the evaluator can see wins created by removal-triggered gravity cascades.
